title: Projective-line proper base change
statement:
For every scheme $S$, the projection $\mathbf P^1_S\to S$ of the projective line $\mathbf P^1_S=\mathbf P(\{0,1\};S)$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change] satisfies
$\mathrm{PBC}$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-property].

proof.text: Let $S$ be a scheme, $X=\mathbf P^1_S=\mathbf P(\{0,1\};S)$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change] and $p:X\to S$ the projection. The morphism $p$ is proper by [lemma-nagata-projective-space-base-change-proper], so $\mathrm{PBC}(p)$ of [def-weil-pbc-property] is defined, and by the implication (2)$\Rightarrow$(1) of [lemma-weil-pbc-property-iff-acyclicity] it suffices to prove $\mathrm{IA}_r(p)$ of [def-weil-pbc-injective-acyclicity-property] for every prime $r$. So fix a prime $r$, a morphism $g:T\to S$, the cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] with $X'=X\times_ST$, $p'=f':X'\to T$, $g':X'\to X$, and an injective sheaf $I$ of $\mathbf F_r$-modules on $X_{\Et}$; we must show $R^qp'_*g'^{-1}I=0$ for $q>0$. By [lemma-nagata-projective-space-base-change-pullback] the square with $\mathbf P^1_T\to\mathbf P^1_S$ on top is cartesian, so we may take $X'=\mathbf P^1_T$ with $p'$ its projection, which is the setting of the geometric-stalk lemma used in the next step. (In the Lean this reduction is [lem-weil-pbc-injective-acyclicity-bounded-below], the implication (2)$\Rightarrow$(1) stated for bounded below complexes with torsion cohomology and any coefficient ring.)

source.place: Theorem Tag 095T (theorem-proper-base-change), proof, last paragraph (condition (2) of Lemma Tag 0A4B suffices); Lemma Tag 0A4B (lemma-proper-base-change-in-terms-of-injectives)

proof.text: Let $F$ be any torsion abelian sheaf on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]; the case needed below is the underlying abelian sheaf of $I$, which is killed by $r$ and hence torsion. Let $\bar t\to T$ be a geometric point and $\bar s=g\circ\bar t$ its image in $S$, lying over $t\in T$ and $s\in S$. Let $\kappa(\bar s)$ and $\kappa(\bar t)$ be the residue fields of the strict henselizations of $S$ at $\bar s$ and of $T$ at $\bar t$, i.e. the separable closures of $\kappa(s)$ and $\kappa(t)$ inside the fields of $\bar s$ and $\bar t$; both are separably closed, and $g$ induces a field extension $\kappa(\bar s)\subset\kappa(\bar t)$. By [lemma-weil-pbc-p1-exchange-geometric-stalk], for every $q\ge0$ the stalk at $\bar t$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] of the degree-$q$ exchange map $\mathcal H^q(\Ex_{\square,F}):g^{-1}R^qp_*F\to R^qp'_*g'^{-1}F$ of [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange] is identified, by isomorphisms of its source and target, with the pullback map $H^q(\mathbf P^1_{\kappa(\bar s)},F|)\to H^q(\mathbf P^1_{\kappa(\bar t)},F|)$ along $\mathbf P^1_{\kappa(\bar t)}\to\mathbf P^1_{\kappa(\bar s)}$. (That lemma contains the strictly henselian part of the argument, unit step (ii): the stalk formula $(R^qp_*F)_{\bar s}=H^q(\mathbf P^1_{\mathcal O^{sh}_{S,\bar s}},F|)$ and the comparison $H^q(\mathbf P^1_{\mathcal O^{sh}},F|)\cong H^q(\mathbf P^1_{\kappa(\bar s)},F|)$ of [prop-weil-pbc-p1-strict-henselian-comparison], through [prop-weil-pbc-strict-local-exchange].) (The Lean builds the derived inverse-image adjunction behind $\Ex_{\square,F}$ from a flat separator of the category of étale sheaves of modules, [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-flat-separator].)

source.place: Theorem Tag 095T (theorem-proper-base-change), proof, paragraphs 2-4 (the strictly henselian comparison, the stalk formula via Theorem Tag 03Q9, and the stalk of the base change map at $\bar t$)

proof.text: Put $k=\kappa(\bar s)\subset k'=\kappa(\bar t)$ and $C=\mathbf P^1_k$. Then $C$ is proper over $k$ by [lemma-nagata-projective-space-base-change-proper] (with $S=\operatorname{Spec}k$) and of dimension at most one by [lem-weil-pbc-p1-field-dimension-one]; by [lemma-nagata-projective-space-base-change-pullback] (with $g:\operatorname{Spec}k'\to\operatorname{Spec}k$) the base change $C_{k'}=C\times_kk'$ is $\mathbf P^1_{k'}$, and its projection to $C$ is the map $\mathbf P^1_{\kappa(\bar t)}\to\mathbf P^1_{\kappa(\bar s)}$ of the previous step. The restriction $F|_C$ is torsion, because its geometric stalks are geometric stalks of $F$ by [lemma-openclosed-stalk-upperstar]. Hence [prop-weil-pbc-proper-curve-sepclosed-invariance], applied to $k\subset k'$, $C$ and $F|_C$, shows that the pullback $H^q(\mathbf P^1_{k},F|)\to H^q(\mathbf P^1_{k'},F|)$ is an isomorphism for every $q$. This is where the curve calculations (unit step (i)) enter: that proposition is the invariance $(C_6)/(C_7)$ for algebraically closed fields [prop-weil-pbc-algebraically-closed-extension], passed to separably closed fields through universal homeomorphisms.

source.place: Theorem Tag 095T (theorem-proper-base-change), proof, paragraph 4 ("Since $\kappa(s)^{sep}\subset\kappa(t)^{sep}$ this map is an isomorphism by Lemma 0A5E"); Lemma Tag 0A5E (lemma-base-change-dim-1-separably-closed)

proof.text: By the two previous steps, for every torsion abelian sheaf $F$ on $X_{\Et}$ and every $q\ge0$ the degree-$q$ exchange map $g^{-1}R^qp_*F\to R^qp'_*g'^{-1}F$ is an isomorphism at every geometric stalk of $T$, hence an isomorphism of sheaves on $T_{\Et}$ by [lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative].

source.place: Theorem Tag 095T (theorem-proper-base-change), proof, paragraph 5 ("This proves cohomology commutes with base change for $\mathbf P^1_S\to S$ and sheaves of $\mathbf Z/\ell\mathbf Z$-modules")

proof.text: Apply the previous step to $F=I$ (as an abelian sheaf). Since $I$ is injective among sheaves of $\mathbf F_r$-modules, $R^qp_*I=0$ for $q>0$ by [lem-weil-pbc-injective-module-direct-image-acyclic], hence $g^{-1}R^qp_*I=0$, and the isomorphism of the previous step gives $R^qp'_*g'^{-1}I=0$ for $q>0$. As $r$, $g$ and $I$ were arbitrary, this is $\mathrm{IA}_r(p)$ for every prime $r$ [def-weil-pbc-injective-acyclicity-property], and by the reduction of the first step $\mathrm{PBC}(p)$ holds.

source.place: Theorem Tag 095T (theorem-proper-base-change), proof, paragraph 5 ("In particular, for an injective sheaf of $\mathbf Z/\ell\mathbf Z$-modules the higher direct images of any base change are zero")

blueprint_sketch.statement:
For every scheme $S$, the projection $\mathbf P^1_S\to S$ satisfies
$\mathsf{PBC}$.
blueprint_sketch.proof:
At every geometric $\bar t\to T$, the exchange map is the field-extension
map of the preceding lemma. The two residue fields are separably closed and
the fibre is a proper curve, so proper-curve invariance makes this map an
isomorphism. Geometric stalk conservativity gives an isomorphism of every
$R^q$ sheaf. Specializing to inverse images of injective
$\mathbf F_\ell$-module sheaves gives $\mathsf{IA}$ after every base change;
the S0 equivalence gives $\mathsf{PBC}$.

split_report.summary: Rewrote the one-paragraph imported proof as five steps following the projective-line part of the proof of Stacks Theorem 095T (with Lemmas 0A4B and 0A5E), realizing the four steps of unit sk-thm-p1: reduction to IA_r via lemma-weil-pbc-property-iff-acyclicity (unit step 1); geometric-stalk identification of the degree-q exchange map with the pullback between projective lines over the separably closed residue fields of the strict henselizations via lemma-weil-pbc-p1-exchange-geometric-stalk (which carries unit step (ii)); invariance of curve cohomology under separably closed extension via prop-weil-pbc-proper-curve-sepclosed-invariance (unit step (i)); conservativity of geometric stalks and the vanishing of R^q p_* of an injective (unit step (iii)). The imported proof used the conservativity and iff lemmas without naming them in a step (only in proof_deps) and silently used: properness of P^1_S -> S and the base change identification P^1_S x_S T = P^1_T (now the closed nodes lemma-nagata-projective-space-base-change-proper / -pullback of units sk-lem-nagata-sketch-affine-cover / sk-thm-reduction; finished nodes, so not route), dim P^1_k <= 1 (new node lem-weil-pbc-p1-field-dimension-one), torsionness of a restriction (lemma-openclosed-stalk-upperstar), and the vanishing of the abelian higher direct images of an injective F_r-module sheaf (new node lem-weil-pbc-injective-module-direct-image-acyclic, Stacks 03FD + 072W). stmt_deps: removed def-weil-pbc-injective-acyclicity-property (not used by the statement; now a proof dependency), added def-nagata-projective-space-base-change for P^1_S. The statement is unchanged except that it names the projective line's definition.
